I’ve tried quite a few bánh mì shops around Hanoi, and this is easily one of the best.
Apr 2026 • Couples
I’ve tried quite a few bánh mì shops around Hanoi, and this is easily one of the best.

The bread is perfectly crispy, the fillings are fresh and full of flavor, and you can really tell they use high-quality ingredients. The fresh vegetables and homemade sauces make every bite even better.

Everything is prepared with great care, and the flavors are well balanced. If you’re looking for an authentic Vietnamese bánh mì experience in Hanoi, this place is absolutely worth a visit.

Highly recommended—I would definitely come back again!

One of the top-rated bánh mì spots in Hanoi’s Old Quarter, and it definitely lives up to the reputation.
Apr 2026 • Family
One of the top-rated bánh mì spots in Hanoi’s Old Quarter, and it definitely lives up to the reputation.

Everything is made fresh, and you can really taste the quality of the ingredients. We highly recommend the beef bánh mì and grilled chicken bánh mì—both were packed with flavor.

We also tried the salted pork knuckle, which is one of the most recommended items on Google Maps, and it didn’t disappoint.

Don’t miss the Greek yogurt either—fresh, creamy, and absolutely delicious.

We enjoyed it so much that we came back more than once during our stay. Highly recommended if you’re visiting Hanoi! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
